Módulo Analytics

Payoffs y volatilidad implícita.

Payoffs

Incluye vanilla, estrategias (spreads, straddles, butterflies), digitales, Asian (media aritmética) y barrier (8 combinaciones up/down × in/out × call/put).

Payoffs de opciones y estrategias.

Incluye: - Vanilla y estrategias (spreads, straddles, butterflies, etc.) - Digitales (cash-or-nothing, asset-or-nothing) - Asian (media aritmética, path-dependent) - Barrier (up/down, in/out, call/put; path-dependent)

Todas las funciones aceptan escalares o arrays de NumPy. S: precio del subyacente al vencimiento (o S_avg para Asian). K, K1, K2, B: strikes y barreras.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_BearCS(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Bear Call Spread: Call(K2) - Call(K1).

Short call en K1, long call en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_BearPS(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Bear Put Spread: Put(K2) - Put(K1).

Short put en K1, long put en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_BullCS(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Bull Call Spread: Call(K1) - Call(K2).

Long call en K1, short call en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_BullPS(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Bull Put Spread: Put(K1) - Put(K2).

Long put en K1, short put en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_CButterflyS(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, K3: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Call Butterfly: Call(K1) - 2*Call(K2) + Call(K3).

Convención: K1 < K2 < K3 (K2 suele ser ATM).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_PButterflyS(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, K3: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Put Butterfly: Put(K1) - 2*Put(K2) + Put(K3).

Convención: K1 < K2 < K3 (K2 suele ser ATM).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_asian_call(S_avg: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción Asian call (media aritmética).

max(S_avg - K, 0). S_avg es el precio promedio del subyacente durante la vida. Path-dependent: requiere S_avg calculado del camino.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_asian_put(S_avg: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción Asian put (media aritmética).

max(K - S_avg, 0). Path-dependent.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_asset_or_nothing_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción asset-or-nothing call.

S si S > K, 0 en caso contrario.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_asset_or_nothing_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción asset-or-nothing put.

S si S < K, 0 en caso contrario.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_down_in_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Down-and-In Call: activa si el precio alcanza B (B < S_0).

Vanilla call payoff si barrier_hit, 0 si no.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_down_in_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Down-and-In Put: activa si el precio alcanza B (B < S_0).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_down_out_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Down-and-Out Call: se anula si el precio alcanza B (B < S_0).

Vanilla call payoff si NO barrier_hit, 0 si sí.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_down_out_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Down-and-Out Put: se anula si el precio alcanza B (B < S_0).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_up_in_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Up-and-In Call: activa si el precio alcanza B (B > S_0).

Vanilla call payoff si barrier_hit, 0 si no.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_up_in_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Up-and-In Put: activa si el precio alcanza B (B > S_0).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_up_out_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Up-and-Out Call: se anula si el precio alcanza B (B > S_0).

Vanilla call payoff si NO barrier_hit, 0 si sí.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_barrier_up_out_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, B: float | ndarray, barrier_hit: bool | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff Up-and-Out Put: se anula si el precio alcanza B (B > S_0).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_bear_call_spread(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray

Payoff de un Bear Call Spread: Call(K2) - Call(K1).

Short call en K1, long call en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_bear_put_spread(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray

Payoff de un Bear Put Spread: Put(K2) - Put(K1).

Short put en K1, long put en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_box(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un box spread: Call(K1) - Put(K1) - Call(K2) + Put(K2).

Equivale a K2 - K1 (constante, sin riesgo de mercado). Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_bull_call_spread(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray

Payoff de un Bull Call Spread: Call(K1) - Call(K2).

Long call en K1, short call en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_bull_put_spread(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray

Payoff de un Bull Put Spread: Put(K1) - Put(K2).

Long put en K1, short put en K2. Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción call europea.

max(S - K, 0)

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_call_butterfly(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, K3: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray

Payoff de un Call Butterfly: Call(K1) - 2*Call(K2) + Call(K3).

Convención: K1 < K2 < K3 (K2 suele ser ATM).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_collar(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un collar: S + Put(K1) - Call(K2).

Long subyacente + long put (floor) + short call (cap). Convención: K1 < K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_combo(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un combo / risk reversal: Call(K2) - Put(K1).

Convención típica: K1 < K2 (call OTM arriba, put OTM abajo).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_condor(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, K3: float | ndarray, K4: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Condor (long): Call(K1) - Call(K2) - Call(K3) + Call(K4).

Long call spread bajo + long call spread alto. Convención: K1 < K2 < K3 < K4.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_covered_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de covered call: S - Call(K).

Long subyacente + short call. Cede upside a cambio de prima.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_covered_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de covered put: Put(K) - S.

Short subyacente + long put. Protege la posición corta.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_digital_call(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, Q: float | ndarray = 1.0) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción digital call (cash-or-nothing).

Q si S > K, 0 en caso contrario. Q: monto fijo pagado si la opción termina in-the-money.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_digital_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray, Q: float | ndarray = 1.0) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción digital put (cash-or-nothing).

Q si S < K, 0 en caso contrario.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_forwardSintetico(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un forward sintético (long): Call(K) - Put(K).

Equivale a S - K (posición larga en forward).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_forward_sintetico(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray

Payoff de un forward sintético (long): Call(K) - Put(K).

Equivale a S - K (posición larga en forward).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_iron_butterfly(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, K3: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Iron Butterfly: Put(K1) - Put(K2) + Call(K3) - Call(K2).

Short straddle en K2 + long strangle (put K1, call K3). Convención: K1 < K2 < K3 (K2 suele ser ATM).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_iron_condor(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, K3: float | ndarray, K4: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un Iron Condor: Put(K1) - Put(K2) - Call(K3) + Call(K4).

Long put spread (K1<K2) + long call spread (K3<K4). Convención: K1 < K2 < K3 < K4.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_protective_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de protective put: S + Put(K).

Long subyacente + long put. Protección a la baja (floor en K).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_put(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de una opción put europea.

max(K - S, 0)

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_put_butterfly(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, K3: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray

Payoff de un Put Butterfly: Put(K1) - 2*Put(K2) + Put(K3).

Convención: K1 < K2 < K3 (K2 suele ser ATM).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_ratio_spread(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray, n1: int = 1, n2: int = 2) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un ratio spread: n1*Call(K1) - n2*Call(K2).

Convención: K1 < K2. Típico 1:2 (comprar 1 call, vender 2 calls).

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_short_straddle(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un short straddle: -(Call(K) + Put(K)).

Beneficio cuando S se mantiene cerca de K.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_short_strangle(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un short strangle: -(Call(K1) + Put(K2)).

Convención típica OTM: K1 > K2.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_straddle(S: float | ndarray, K: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un straddle (long): Call(K) + Put(K).

Beneficio cuando el subyacente se mueve fuerte en cualquier dirección.

Codigo.analytics.payoffs.payoff_strangle(S: float | ndarray, K1: float | ndarray, K2: float | ndarray) → float | ndarray[source]

Payoff de un strangle (long): Call(K1) + Put(K2).

Convención típica OTM: K1 > K2 (call strike arriba, put strike abajo).
